code:
from awq import AutoAWQForCausalLM
from transformers import AutoTokenizer

model = AutoAWQForCausalLM.from_pretrained("meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct")
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct")

model.quantize(tok, quant_config={"zero_point": True, "q_group_size": 128, "w_bit": 4})
model.save_quantized("./llama-3.1-8b-awq")
caption: A calibration pass runs automatically inside .quantize() — no manual dataset wiring required.
